besluite.rede: The relative clause reads naturally, says the same thing, and leaves the protected wordings in the paragraph untouched.

besluite.fout: 'klip met goud in uit die grond haal' stacks prepositions awkwardly.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons, so only the writer may reword it.
'sy' naturally points to the mine and either reading means the same, while 'in die myn' narrows the work to underground and rewords a shared glossary definition.
